identity.name: Ballon Bleu de Cartier
identity.one_liner: Cartier's round sports-dress case, identified by a fluted crown set with a blue cabochon under an arched guard rather than by any bezel detail.

narrative.story: Cartier launched the Ballon Bleu in 2007 as a round case sitting apart from the rectangular Tank family, distinguished by a curved crown guard over a fluted crown set with a blue cabochon-cut synthetic spinel. The 42mm steel automatic sits at the larger end of a range that also runs down to smaller quartz sizes, and the line has become one of Cartier's two standard round-case options alongside the far older Pasha.
narrative.collector_notes: The cabochon crown is a common wear and damage point from repeated winding and date-setting; check that it is original, undamaged, and screws down smoothly before assuming a listing photo represents the watch's actual condition.
